summary:
Iteration 10 backend+frontend tested. Backend 6/7 pass — 1 bug found on guests validation (value=0 accepted as 1 instead of 400). Frontend: fridge PDF renders in EXACTLY 2 pages via Playwright (A4 9mm margin, print_background), HTML contains 7
, 28
    (each with recipe steps, none empty), 134 grammages ('g'), PAGE 1/2 and PAGE 2/2 both present. Menus print-fridge flow triggers window.print without JS errors. Recipe screen /recipe?week=0&day=0&meal=lunch — people-2 shows 'Repas invités pour 2 personnes' hint and persists after reload (guests saved server-side); people-1 hides hint. Tracker weigh-reminder visible; tapping 'Peser' (weigh-now) opens the sheet with weight-kg input. No unhandled JS errors (RN web shadow*/pointerEvents warnings filtered). Regressions (generate/recap/backup) all 200.

minor.issue: value=0 returns 200 instead of 400. Root cause: `n = int(payload.value or 1)` in server.py line 465 — 0 is falsy in Python so gets coerced to 1, then passes the 1≤n≤8 check. Fix: `n = int(payload.value) if payload.value is not None else 1`. Note: value=9 correctly returns 400.

action_items: Backend: fix `int(payload.value or 1)` for action=guests in /app/backend/server.py:465 so value=0 returns HTTP 400 (change to `int(payload.value) if payload.value is not None else 1`). Currently value=0 is silently treated as 1.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py guests validation uses `payload.value or 1` which fails for value=0 (Python falsy). This is the only functional deviation from spec.
buildFridgeHtml (export.ts) — page 2 legend appended inside the second .grid (grid-column:1/-1 span) is elegant and holds up cleanly in 2 pages A4 (rendered PDF confirms).
Recipe screen guests state syncs server-side (guests field on meal), persists across reload — good.

Playwright chromium already installed at /pw-browsers. Backend pytest: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10.py -v` (2 workers via xdist). Login testuser1@test.fr/testpass123 works; program is 'Programme du 12/09/2026 (restauré) (restauré)' with 4 weeks.
rca_of_issue: Bug: POST /api/programs/{id}/meals/action with {action:'guests', value:0} returns 200 instead of 400. Reproduction: signup+generate → POST action=guests value=0 → response 200 with guests=1 in day.meals.dinner. Root cause: server.py:465 `n = int(payload.value or 1)` — Python evaluates `0 or 1` as `1`, so 0 never reaches the `if not (1 <= n <= 8)` guard. Mitigation: replace with `n = int(payload.value) if payload.value is not None else 1` (explicit None check). The value=9 case works because int(9 or 1)==9 fails the range check correctly.
